report.summary: Both failures come from one product bug: `validate_book` in app/main.py:83 accepts years up to next year (`this_year + 1`), but the error message and both tests say the maximum is the current year. The API test gets 201 instead of 422, and the UI test never sees the error element because the book is saved. Fix the bound in app/main.py first, then rerun both tests.

causes.title: Books with next year's date are accepted instead of rejected
causes.explanation: validate_book computes the upper bound as this_year + 1, so a year one past the current year passes validation and the book is inserted. The rejection message in the same function reads "Year must be between 1 and {this_year}", which means the intended maximum is the current year. The API test (next-year case) and the UI test both expect a next-year book to be rejected with that message, so the application is wrong and the tests are right. The test's THIS_YEAR+1 input uses date.today() just like the app, so the result does not depend on timing and fails on every run. The UI test fails as a consequence: the book is saved and redirected, so the element with data-testid="error" never renders.
evidence: app/main.py:84: raise HTTPException(422, f"Year must be between 1 and {this_year}")
tests/api/test_books_api.py:66: assert response.status_code == 422 (actual: assert 201 == 422, status 201 Created)
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:42-44: books.add(title, "Someone", str(date.today().year + 1)); expect(books.error).to_contain_text("Year must be between")
Playwright failure: waiting for get_by_test_id("error") ... Actual value: None; aria snapshot shows row "Future-5856a016 Someone 2027 Delete" was created
tests/api/test_books_api.py:47-50: test_current_year_is_accepted expects THIS_YEAR to be accepted, which the current bound also allows
causes.suggested_fix: Change app/main.py:83 to `if not 1 <= book.year <= this_year:`. The UI path uses the same insert_book/validate_book code, so this fixes both tests. Also add a regression test asserting that the current year is accepted and the next year is rejected, and check the git history for when the +1 was introduced.
